subject: Joint action plan template + week-by-week matrix for HelixAI evaluation
messages:
From: Samir Banerjee <samir@helixai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@helixai.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft action plan / template to get us started

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Priya and I spent a bit of time talking through next steps and we want to move quickly on a short evaluation (4 weeks) to validate latency/cost and a small pilot integration.

Do you have a preferred action-plan template you use with customers? If you can share a one-page week-by-week matrix plus a minimal acceptance checklist, we can drop it into our internal review and share procurement timelines.

High level asks from our side:
- Week-by-week milestones (onboarding, infra validation, pilot run, acceptance)
- Roles + owners for each milestone (we'll map ours after you send yours)
- Minimal acceptance criteria (latency P95 target, token cost target, sample pass rate)

Also can you call out where security evidence (SOC2, data retention) would fit? Priya will lead that side.

Best,
Samir
Sr. Product Manager
HelixAI

Attachments: none
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samir Banerjee <samir@helixai.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@helixai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft action plan / template to get us started

Samir —

Appreciate the fast follow. I attached our lightweight action-plan template and a week-by-week matrix (two files): helixai_action-plan_template_v1.docx and week-by-week_matrix_v1.xlsx. I also created a collaborative Google Doc draft for the MAP so your team can comment directly: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1HlxMapDraft

A few notes up front:
- We typically run a 3–6 week evaluation depending on integration scope; 4 weeks is a solid default for a pilot focused on inference perf + basic integration.
- Acceptance criteria: P95 latency threshold, token cost budget, and a simple quality gate based on a 50-sample prompt set. I added placeholder numbers in the doc — please update to match your targets.
- Security/compliance: we include a \"Evidence & Security Owner\" row per milestone. SOC2 artifacts and the security questionnaire are normally tracked in a Confluence page or attachments; I've noted the KMS/HSM and data-retention checkpoints in week 1/2.

Proposed next steps:
1) Your team edits the doc with your owners/targets by EOD Tue (20 Jan).
2) Joint alignment call (30 min) — propose Mon 19 Jan 10:00 PT or Tue 20 Jan 09:00 PT.
3) We finalize and lock the MAP; Redwood will spin a dedicated trial instance and provide onboarding checklist.

I'm looping Marissa (CS lead) to suggest acceptance criteria and Diego for the SOC2/technical evidence questions.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: helixai_action-plan_template_v1.docx (docx), week-by-week_matrix_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Samir Banerjee <samir@helixai.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@helixai.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft action plan / template to get us started

Mina / Samir —

Thanks for pulling the draft together, Mina. Quick additions from the CS side (I pasted into the doc as well):

> Acceptance checklist (examples)
>- P95 inference latency ≤ 180ms on your peak test workload (we listed baseline numbers in the sheet)
>- Average inference cost per 1k tokens ≤ $0.45 under batch policy X
>- Functional pass rate: ≥ 90% on 50 labeled prompts across core intents

Operational milestones I added to the week-by-week matrix:
- Week 0 (prep): account access, model selection, test dataset handoff
- Week 1: infra smoke test, basic throughput validation, KV cache baseline
- Week 2: pilot run with shadow traffic, initial quality checkpoints
- Week 3: tuning (batching/quantization suggestions), economy checks
- Week 4: acceptance run + knowledge-transfer docs

Owners (initial):
- Redwood AE: Mina Haddad
- Redwood CS: Marissa Cole
- Redwood Security lead (for evidence): Diego Fernandez
- HelixAI PM: Samir Banerjee
- HelixAI Eng: Priya Menon

I kept the acceptance criteria conservative; we can loosen once we see baseline numbers. Also added a short \"rollback / fallback\" note in case of perf regressions (route to smaller model, increased batching).

—Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Menon <priya.m@helixai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Banerjee <samir@helixai.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft action plan / template to get us started

Mina / Marissa —

Thanks — this looks useful. Confirming a 4-week cadence works for us provided we get the security artifacts in week 1 so procurement can move. A couple of asks from our side:

- Can Diego point to the SOC2 report or a SOC2 scope summary we can share with procurement?
- For the acceptance run, can Redwood include a token-cost breakdown per model variant (open quantized vs default) so we can sanity-check economics?
- Proposed alignment call: Mon 19 Jan 10:00 PT (Samir and I will join).

We will update owners in the doc prior to the call and add target latency/cost numbers. Looking forward to the alignment call.

Regards,
Priya Menon
Head of Integrations
HelixAI
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samir Banerjee <samir@helixai.com>, Priya Menon <priya.m@helixai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft action plan / template to get us started

Samir / Priya —

Great — finalizing a few things ahead of the 10:00 PT sync:

- Confirmed: Mon 19 Jan 2026, 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).
- Doc link (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1HlxMapDraft — please add your owners/targets before the call.
- Diego, can you attach or point Samir/Priya to the SOC2 summary (or a conduit link) in the doc? If there are any redlines on retention/KMS we should flag them on the call.
- Action items I added to the doc: onboarding checklist, sample-set handoff (Samir), trial instance details (Redwood), and a tentative acceptance-run date in week 4 (Feb 12).

If Helix wants a short slide summary (1–2 slides) for procurement, Marissa and I can assemble it after the call.

Thanks everyone — see you on the call.

Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
